target_gates.description: The eagle head and hooked beak remain unambiguous.
Two feathered wings and avian forequarters attach coherently.
Lion torso, rear legs, paws, and tail define the rear half.
Feather-to-fur and skeletal junctions read as one anatomy.
Horse hindquarters, a lion head, a plain eagle, or detached collage parts do not substitute.
An ash nest, charred remnant, or exhausted former body anchors the prior state.
One coherent renewed bird emerges from that same anchor.
Ash, ember filaments, and feathers form one contiguous transition.
Wing posture, falling ash, and sparks establish upward emergence.
A flaming bird, fire wings, unrelated second bird, or ashes alone does not substitute.
